title: A Representative Sampling Method for Peer Encouragement Designs in Network Experiments
authors: Yanyan Li; Sha Yang; Qing Liu
eligible_reason: Methods paper (representative ego-network sampling for peer encouragement experiments). Results are simulations on public and simulated networks; treatment effects are difference-in-means/CATE estimators on simulated experiments. No panel, no DiD.
design_notes: 05_causal_inference.py computes ATE/CATE (difference in means, exposure-based estimators) on simulated encouragement assignments over sampled ego networks; Tables 1-3 are sampling diagnostics.
data_files_note: README: LastFM, Twitch and Pokec network data must be downloaded separately into data/; simulated networks are generated by 01_prepare_networks.py.
data_provenance_note: Public network data not shipped (download links in README); remaining inputs are simulated networks. Moot (no DiD).
software_notes: Python pipeline (01-05) plus R figure scripts.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available at screening time (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked); screened from the package README, code, shipped data and the OpenAlex abstract. Title of package README/code matches the paper (no mismatch).
